newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 3.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Laurent Dona-Fologo, minister of national solidarity and general secretary of the ruling PDCI, said in a radio interview that France "should take note of today's realities and understand that it is not alone in Africa". The Ivorian market was completely open to U.S. investors, he said.
- A consortium led by Canada's Ranger Oil is the latest group to begin looking for oil in the waters off Ivory Coast, following an agreement signed in March.

- The Privatisation Committee is still deliberating over the various bids for state sugar firm SODESUCRE. A final decision is expected next week. Next in line is textile company CIDT, which the government wants to privatise before the start of the next cotton season in January.
